/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os,re
root='src'
# rough parser: collect class simple name, extends simple name, file
classes=[]
for dirpath,_,files in os.walk(root):
  for fn in files:
    if not fn.endswith('.java'): continue
    path=os.path.join(dirpath,fn)
    text=open(path).read()
    # strip comments/strings? enough for class headers
    for m in re.finditer(r'\\b(?:class|interface|enum)\\s+(\\w+)\\b(["'^'"\\{;]*)\\{', text):
      name=m.group(1); header=m.group(2)
      em=re.search(r'\\bextends\\s+([\\w\\.]+)', header)
      ext=em.group(1).split('.')[-1] if em else None
      classes.append((name,ext,path,m.start()))
# compute simple class names extending ForwardingObject transitive
hier={'ForwardingObject'}
changed=True
while changed:
  changed=False
  for name,ext,path,pos in classes:
    if ext in hier and name not in hier:
      hier.add(name); changed=True
print('hier size',len(hier))
print('\\n'.join(sorted(hier)))
PY"
